svg.text: Bias–variance split, bounded for any ridge

g.title: Method starts from the kernel-ridge estimator and splits the test error into bias and variance
g.desc: method starts from the kernel-ridge estimator splits the test error into a bias term and a variance term each bounded with high probability
g.text: Regularized least squares over the RKHS:
Test error splits cleanly into two terms:
bias = noiseless error · variance = label-noise error — each bounded w.h.p.

g.title: Key ingredients: careful ridge algebra, sub-Gaussian covariance concentration, Neumann series
g.desc: key ingredients careful algebra on the ridge terms a sub-Gaussian covariance concentration inequality and a Neumann-series expansion
g.text: Careful algebra on the ridge terms

g.title: That lets the bounds hold for any ridge value
g.desc: that lets the bounds hold for any ridge value chosen independently of the sample size
g.text: Valid for λ chosen independently of N —
not only for a ridge that shrinks with the sample.
